structured_summary: The robot announces a package delivery; the recipient must acknowledge the delivery within 8 seconds, after which the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The recipient should acknowledge the delivery within 8 seconds.
Once acknowledged, the robot must confirm the delivery within 1 second.

missing_details: modality of announcement, acknowledgment, and confirmation (e.g., speech, gesture, button)
failure behavior if deadlines are exceeded (e.g., retry, abort)
whether the 8‑second and 1‑second windows start at the end of the preceding utterance or at its onset
potential_ambiguities: whether 'acknowledge' requires a verbal response or any action
whether 'confirm' is a robot utterance or a signal
whether the timing windows are inclusive or exclusive of the trigger event
